description_en: Creates an identity provider (IdP) for role-based single sign-on (SSO)
description_zh: 创建一个角色SSO的身份提供商配置
kebab_example: aliyun ims create-saml-provider --saml-provider-name test-provider --description This_is_a_provider. --encoded-saml-metadata-document PD94bWwgdmVy0000 --authn-sign-algo rsa-sha1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSAMLProvider

parameters.help_en:
The IdP name.

It can be up to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, `periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)`. The name cannot start or end with `periods (.), hyphens (-), or underscores (_)`
parameters.help_zh:
身份提供商名称。

最大长度128个字符，允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_`，不能以特殊字符`.-_`开头或结尾
parameters.name: saml_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The metadata file, which is Base64-encoded.

The file is provided by an IdP that supports Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0
parameters.help_zh:
元数据文档。经过Base64编码。

由支持SAML2.0协议的身份提供商提供
parameters.name: encoded_saml_metadata_document

parameters.help_en:
The supported signature algorithm. Valid values:

rsa-sha256

rsa-sha1 (default)
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云SP支持的签名算法。取值：

rsa-sha256
rsa-sha1（默认值）
parameters.name: authn_sign_algo
